ads.text:
Why wait for a subsidy when you can start saving from day one?

With the Atria Subsidy, Bengaluru homeowners get benefits worth ₹75,000 on a 3 kW rooftop system, paid upfront. You pay only the balance.

✔ 3 kW systems from ₹1.42 lakh after the Atria Subsidy

✔ For independent houses with a monthly bill above ₹1,200

✔ Financing options available

✔ 4.9 on Google from 100+ reviews

✔ 66+ year legacy, from the founders of ACT

Tap Get Offer to book a free site survey, or call +91 99011 00428.

ad_library.summary: One active Meta ad card captured on 2026-11-23; this is a sample, not necessarily the total. Google Ads activity was not checked.

score_basis: 0 points from measured formula checks. Unknown checks are excluded; zero is not a clean bill of health.

page_count.note: robots.txt declares /sitemap.xml; sitemap fetch failed, so contents and indexing are unverified.

conversion_evidence.method: Public page text and selected served source; no browser interaction or form submission.
rows: Corporate homepage Contact us links to /contact-us.
Contact page has a form; homepage form and submission unverified.
Homepage has a tel link; WhatsApp not verified.
Homepage lists projects; testimonials and pricing not verified.
Live chat and offer popup require browser verification.

site_audit.scope_note: The card says Get offer and links to fb.me; its final form was not tested. The separately reviewed corporate contact page has a form. Wix source review is partial; event firing remains unverified.
site_audit.html_errors: 979 errors, 0 warnings, 22 info (checker hit message cap; includes 7 HTML errors)

issues: The card shows fb.me and Get offer; verify the actual destination and survey booking flow.
The corporate homepage features solar, wind and hydro; its rooftop link points to a separate domain.
The homepage checker hit its message cap; do not treat the total as a count of actionable HTML defects.
wins: Corporate homepage links to contact and a phone number.
Contact page contains a form; submission untested.

site_evidence.note: Selected served source reviewed; absence and runtime behavior are unverified.

promise_gap: Ad: 3 kW from ₹1.42 lakh after Atria Subsidy.
The reviewed corporate homepage is not the confirmed ad destination and does not establish this offer. Verify terms in the live form and the rooftop site.
Ad: book a free survey via Get Offer.
The card shows fb.me; the booking flow and survey delivery were not tested.
recommended_steps: Check the mobile post-click flow and lead handoff.
Confirm price, subsidy terms and eligibility wherever the offer is shown.
Inspect runtime events and account configuration with consent.
Separate actionable markup findings from Wix CSS diagnostics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
